description: This file defines a React component named SessionsByType that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by session type. It imports various chart components from 'recharts', utility functions for theming and color mapping, and formats labels and tooltips for the chart.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Truncates a label string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a custom tooltip for the chart, displaying session type and count.
